remarks: Welcome to Eastside! Introducing this custom Modern Farmhouse, ground-up construction home in highly soughtafter Eastside Costa Mesa. Thoughtfully designed, a stunning blend of timeless character and contemporary luxury, thoughtfully crafted with high-end custom finishes and architectural detailing throughout. Situated on a very private, family-oriented, tree-lined street just a few blocks from Brentwood Park, this home offers an exceptional lifestyle location. Enter through the custom oversized solid wood pivot entry door onto 10” wide-plank engineered hardwood flooring that flows seamlessly throughout. Exposed ceiling beams and decorative rafters accent the open-concept living space
